items.prompt: After selecting B because it wins validation, what is its validation score?

options.why: Evaluate the frozen procedure on later held-out data.

options.text: An unbiased estimate of the selected winner because each candidate score was unbiased before selection
options.why: Optimizing noisy scores can select upward noise; unbiased individual estimates do not make the selected maximum unbiased.

items.explanation: Selection is part of fitting the research procedure.
